// Article-specific bespoke detection — ToddyCat-Linked Umbrij Malware Abuses OAuth to Access Gmail via Google API
// Hunts the actual binaries / paths / commandline fragments named

| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")
| where (FolderPath has_any ("%LOCALAPPDATA%\Google\Chrome\", "%LOCALAPPDATA%\Microsoft\Edge\.") or FileName in~ ("bdsubwiz.exe", "vstestvideorecorder.exe", "googledesktop.exe"))
